Does the patient have ACUTE, LIFE- 
THREATENING end-organ damage? 
• Hypertensive encephalopathy & retinopathy 
• Haemorrhagic / Ischaemic CVA 
• ACS – STEMI/NSTE-ACS 
• Acute LV dysfunction / Congestive heart failure 
• Acute pulmonary oedema (SCAPE) 
• Aortic dissection 
• Acute renal failure 
• Eclampsia / Pre-eclampsia 
Blood Pressure elevated?

No role in the ED for stat oral antihypertensives 
• Treat the initial presenting 
complaint 
• Screen for TOD – likely true HT if 
present 
• True HT: Discharge on oral 
antihypertensive agents – HCTZ + 
ACE-inhibitor/Ca Channel blocker 
• Reactive HT: reassure, no TTO 
• Follow up at local Clinic for 
repeat BP/Rx continuation
